verdict.rationale: Bruno documents an environment selector dropdown with search filtering and a CLI flag to override global environment variables at runtime, plus per-environment secret manager integrations (Vault, Azure Key Vault, AWS, GCP), all pointing to a working multi-environment variable-set system used to switch between dev/staging/prod. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation walking through creating/switching named environments (dev/staging/prod) and independent hands-on confirmation beyond a single older HN comment wishing for the feature.
